
```jsx
import { CxCard } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxCard from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/card/CxCard'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the base component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **context** | Sets the context context of the component to one of Bootstrap React’s themed colors. | `'primary'` \| `'secondary'` \| `'success'` \| `'danger'` \| `'warning'` \| `'info'` \| `'dark'` \| `'light'` \| `string` | - |
| **textColor** | Sets the text context context of the component to one of Bootstrap React’s themed colors. | `'primary'` \| `'secondary'` \| `'success'` \| `'danger'` \| `'warning'` \| `'info'` \| `'dark'` \| `'light'` \| `'white'` \| `'white-50'` \| `'muted'` \| `'black-50'` \| `'body'` \| `string` | - |
